'''2007 Endor Regionals Phil Aasen DS Fondor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Phil Aasen]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Phillip Aasen
* '''Deck name:''' I've Got A Bad Feeling About This
* '''Username:''' korreshark
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
